answer: The shale I would price into every new account is Proof of unique trail maintenance log: trail work logged by a parks department over seasons, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. What makes this stick is that trail work logged by a parks department over seasons cannot be faked in bulk — each proof is independent, and the dawn of independence is that one compromised proof endangers no other account. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the horizon for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
